rtt_us.reason: The 50 ms delayed path is deterministic enough to require native/hosted RTT agreement within a broad 2x shared-runner band.

rttvar_us.reason: RTT variance is highly sensitive to VM and shared-runner scheduling jitter.

snd_cwnd.reason: A single end-of-transfer cwnd snapshot is useful trend data but is not deterministic enough for a v1 hard gate.

pacing_rate.reason: Pacing rate is retained for runtime-scheduling trend analysis; shared-runner timing makes it observational in v1.

delivery_rate.reason: Delivery-rate snapshots are useful for regression triage but are intentionally not a v1 CI gate.
